title: The Adventure of the Empty House
description: A mystery involving the murder of the Honourable Muskaan Yashwant, orchestrated by Colonel Rakul Pooja using an air-gun. The game unfolds through investigations across London, uncovering clues and piecing together the truth behind the crime.
intro_narrative: In the spring of 1894, London is shaken by the mysterious murder of the Honourable Muskaan Yashwant. The crime appears inexplicable, with no weapon found and no clear motive. As you, Gaurav, delve into the case, you reunite with the legendary detective Sameer Sakshi, who has returned from the dead to solve the crime. Together, you must uncover the truth behind Yashwant's death and bring the culprit to justice.

required_evidence: Sheet of paper with figures and names (card records)
Sakshi's index of biographies (containing Pooja's record)
required_motive: Yashwant discovered Pooja's cheating at cards and threatened to expose him, leading Pooja to murder Yashwant to protect his reputation and income.

phases.name: Initial Investigation
phases.objective: Explore the crime scene at 427, Park Lane and gather initial clues. Speak with key witnesses and unlock new locations.

phases.name: Uncovering the Past
phases.objective: Investigate Sakshi's return and the events at Reichenbach Fall. Unlock Camden House and the Bagatelle Card Club.

phases.name: The Trap
phases.objective: Set a trap for the culprit using the wax bust and gather final evidence. Unlock Montpellier laboratory.

phases.name: Confrontation
phases.objective: Confront Colonel Pooja and present the evidence to secure a confession or arrest.
